coordinate_policy: Times are approximate human review anchors, not frame-exact labels. Never replace them with model output.
module_scope: landing detection only; frozen ball tracking and main-view trail must not change

annotations.label: visual_requirement
annotations.expected: Every confirmed out landing is drawn at its corresponding minimap position as a red X.

annotations.label: premature_then_duplicate_flash
annotations.expected: Do not light the far zone before touchdown; light it once at the true landing.

annotations.label: false_near_and_missed_far
annotations.expected: The near-side own service-box flash is false. Suppress it and recover the subsequent far-side landing.

annotations.label: missed_in_bounds_landing
annotations.expected: Recover the far-side landing near 30 seconds.

annotations.label: missed_serve_landing
annotations.expected: Recover the near-side first landing of the opponent's serve.

annotations.label: missed_lob_landing
annotations.expected: Recover the far-side landing of the near player's lob.

annotations.label: missed_in_bounds_wide_landing
annotations.expected: Recover the opponent's sharply angled in-bounds landing on the near-left side.

annotations.label: premature_landing
annotations.expected: Do not create or flash the far-side landing before physical touchdown; retain only the true landing.

annotations.label: missed_slice_landing
annotations.expected: Recover the far-side landing after the slice.
